result.summary: Found several visual issues including duplicate restaurant cards, truncated text, a partially cut-off card, and a low-contrast favorite icon.

issues.description: Two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards appear side by side in the 'Fastest near you' section with the same image, delivery time, and price.
issues.suggestion: Verify whether this is duplicate data; if so, remove the duplicate entry or differentiate the cards (e.g., by location, address, or branch name).

issues.description: The third restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section shows a truncated name 'Smash Bros Bu' instead of the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow the card title to wrap to a second line or widen the card so the full restaurant name is visible.

issues.description: The second card in the 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen, hiding its restaurant name, rating, and delivery details.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or adjust the scroll container so the last visible card is fully rendered above the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is dark against a dark background, making it hard to see.
issues.suggestion: Add a semi-transparent circular background or use a lighter stroke/fill color to ensure the icon is clearly visible on dark images.
